SELECT coalesce(la.current_stamps, 0) AS current_stamps, coalesce(la.total_stamps, 0) AS total_stamps, r.stamps_required, r.reward_name, r.reward_description, (SELECT count(*) FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'PENDING') AS pending_stamps, (SELECT max(created_at) + make_interval(mins => ( SELECT min_interval_minutes FROM stamp_policies WHERE branch_id IS NULL)) FROM stamps WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND source = 'NFC_TAP' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')) AS next_stamp_at FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts la ON la.customer_id = #{customerId}
JOIN reward_rules r ON r.id = COALESCE(la.reward_rule_id, (SELECT id FROM reward_rules WHERE active))
SELECT id, reward_name_snapshot AS name, earned_at FROM rewards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY earned_at
mapper.update: UPDATE redemptions SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE rewards SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
